purpose: Content-flow reference; implementation preserves the existing Shared UI and approved course styling.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / scientific-educational.
Create a polished 16:9 1600x900 Chinese interactive lecture slide design mockup, for an existing blue-and-white warehouse robot reinforcement learning course. This is a UI design reference, not a runtime screenshot. Maintain a very pale blue background, dark navy Chinese title, blue section headers, white content regions, restrained rounded corners, ample alignment and spacing, professional readable academic visual design.
Exact title: "DQN：让网络替机器人估价".
Subtitle: "神经网络近似动作价值函数，输入状态，一次输出各个动作的长期评分。"
Reading logic: robot's current position -> encode that position -> one shared Q network -> four separate action Q estimates -> choose the largest estimate -> actually move one step.
Composition: two large regions, a 32% wide left warehouse panel and a 68% wide right inference panel. Do not create three equally weighted dashboard cards.
Left region header: "① 输入当前位置". A clean square 7x7 warehouse map with external row/column axes numbered 1 through 7; small blue-and-white wheeled robot at row6 column2, blue selected cell outline, five gray obstacles, green receiving dock at row6 column6 and an orange-cone maintenance pit at row7 column4. Use friendly polished 3D robot and terminal stickers. Beneath map a compact coordinate readout "s = (6, 2)" and the short line "全图用于讲解，网络只输入当前位置". The map uses the same tidy grid style throughout the lesson.
Right region header: "② 同一个网络，同时给四个动作评分". A single broad horizontal inference diagram with generous space. At left a compact position-encoding bar labelled "位置编码 · 49 维", one selected slot. In the center a beautiful restrained blue neural-network schematic on a subtle 3D white-blue module base: representative input nodes, representative hidden nodes, four output nodes connected with fine blue lines. Label central model "共享参数 θ", "24 个 ReLU 单元"; use ellipsis to indicate omitted input and hidden nodes. At right four aligned action rows with direction arrows and exact initial untrained outputs: "向上 −0.06", "向右 −0.02", "向下 −0.08", "向左 −0.14". Give the right row a green outline and a small "最大" label, while negative numerical values remain red. Show signed bars on a zero-centered axis; never imply these are probabilities. Connect network's four outputs to the four Q rows.
Under the diagram a short model statement "换一个位置，仍使用同一组参数"; a visible small note "固定随机初始化 · 尚未训练". Add a neat primary button "计算四个 Q 值" and a secondary button "按最大 Q 走一步", consistent with course blue controls. A short explanatory formula Qθ(s, ·) -> [Q(s,↑), Q(s,→), Q(s,↓), Q(s,←)] may be placed under the network.
Bottom small conclusion strip: "输出是 Q 值，不是动作概率；负值中也可以选最大值。"
Constraints: all content stays fully within the slide, avoid tiny dense copy, overlaid numbers and arrows, gratuitous glow, tech particles, decorative math, logos, page badges, watermarks, tabs, toolbars, unreadable made-up labels. No target direction or surrounding map info in the network input. Clear educational spatial relationships are more important than decorative detail.
